svg.text: Coefficient profile across the 16 extents; non-zero
domains; the peak extent is the scale of effect
each point is a separate model fitted at that extent
global peak: the scale of effect
Each species-period is modelled separately at all 16 spatial extents, giving 160 base model fits.
The scale of effect is the extent at which a predictor’s coefficient is strongest, not the best-fitting model.
